The job will fail at startup if the absolute path specified for the output file (`/ocean/projects/phy210030p/akshay2/Slurm_logs/`) does not already exist.

#

# Ensure that the output directory to SBATCH exists prior to batch script execution.
module load openmpi/3.1.6-gcc8.3.1

# Define environment variables. $PROJECT = /ocean/projects/<group id>/<username>
# The original script assumes $PROJECT is pre-set. This behavior is preserved.
CMDDIR=$PROJECT/HPC_pulsar/cmd_files

# The SLURM environment variable $SLURM_NTASKS is replaced by $FLUX_JOB_NTASKS
echo $FLUX_JOB_NTASKS

# Run acceleration searches within singularity container.
# IMPORTANT: The script being called, 'multinode_accelsearch.cmd', must use
# a Flux-aware MPI launcher (e.g., 'flux run') to correctly start processes
# on the allocated 208 tasks across 8 nodes.
$CMDDIR/multinode_accelsearch.cmd
